title: dianthus glacialis subsp. gelidus
intro: Dianthus glacialis subsp. gelidus, commonly known as the alpine pink or glacier pink, is a flowering plant belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus glacialis subsp. gelidus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties. These constituents have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antimicrobial activities, making this plant a valuable resource for natural medicine.
